subject: Re: Request: Redwood hosted API rate card & NDA process
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Redwood hosted API rate card & NDA process

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked great. Procurement asked me to request your standard hosted-API rate card and to understand your NDA process before we share our usage estimates and get to pricing. A couple of asks to help us move internally:  

- Can you share the current baseline rate card (PDF) for the hosted API?
- Do you require a mutual NDA before sending full pricing (we can sign a mutual NDA if needed).
- Any guidance on discount tiers for committed monthly spend (e.g., 0.5M / 1M / 5M tokens)?
- Versioning: do you ship a single canonical PDF or do you track versions you want on the contract? Procurement likes a versioned artifact.

Tentative timeline: procurement review next Wednesday, so if we can have NDA + rate card before then that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Anna Liu
Director of Product
Acme Corp
anna@acme-corp.com

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood hosted API rate card & NDA process

Hi Anna — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was useful. Quick responses below and next steps:  

1) NDA: We do request a countersigned mutual NDA before sharing the complete rate card PDF with detailed tiered pricing. If Acme prefers, we can start from your standard mutual NDA; otherwise I'll send our standard NDA template via DocuSign.

2) Baseline pricing (high level): I can share a redacted baseline summary (no account-specific discounts) immediately so procurement can start internal discussions. Typical hosted-API list (baseline, non-discounted) is:
   - Starter: $0.0008 / token (up to 200k tokens/mo)
   - Growth: $0.0006 / token (200k–1M tokens/mo)
   - Scale: $0.00045 / token (1M+ tokens/mo)
These are baseline figures; committed annual spend can unlock incremental discounts.

3) Version control: We publish a version number on each rate card PDF (e.g., v1.0, v1.1) and track DocuSign/HubSpot records for countersigned artifacts.

Next steps:
- I'll attach a redacted PDF (baseline only) that you can share with procurement now.
- Lauren (legal) and Monica (sales ops) are looped to route the NDA and finalize the v1.0 PDF once signed.

If that works I will send the DocuSign NDA link by end of day.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_RateCard_Baseline_Redacted.pdf (attachment stub)

Anna
